# Dubai Battery Service

> Mobile car battery help across Dubai, UAE: battery replacement, jump starts, free battery testing, battery delivery and 24/7 emergency help at the driver's location.

Key facts
- Available 24/7 across Dubai, including nights, weekends and public holidays.
- Typical arrival: 20–25 minutes after the location is confirmed (traffic permitting).
- Car batteries from AED 120 supplied and fitted (small cars); large AGM SUV batteries up to about AED 2,000.
- Warranty up to 36 months depending on brand and size. Free battery and alternator test on site.
- All major brands (e.g. Amaron, Varta, Bosch, ACDelco, Exide, Solite) in conventional, EFB and AGM types.
- Contact: WhatsApp or call +971 58 242 4859. Work is carried out by an independent, vetted Dubai mobile battery team.
